events.label: Antarctic blue whale Z-call
events.freq: 26.05 Hz for 9 s, 1.5 s down-sweep, then 18.8 to 18.3 Hz for 9 s; no harmonics
events.level_rule: source level 189 dB re 1 uPa at 1 m, range 1000 km, TL = 60 + 10 log10(R/1 km) dB
events.src: Gavrilov, McCauley & Gedamke 2012 JASA 131:4476 (call shape; 0.135 Hz/yr decline); Leroy et al. 2016 PLoS ONE 11:e0163587 (unit A 26.05 Hz for 2014; units 7-12 s); Sirovic et al. 2007 JASA 122:1208 (source level 189 dB)

events.label: Pygmy blue whale song unit II
events.freq: fundamental up-sweep 19.5 to 25.5 Hz over 23 s; harmonics 2 and 3 at -3 and -6 dB (to 76.5 Hz)
events.level_rule: source level 179 dB re 1 uPa at 1 m, range 100 km, TL = 60 + 10 log10(R/1 km) dB
events.src: Jolliffe et al. 2019 PLoS ONE 14:e0208619 (unit II 20 to 26 Hz over 23 s in 2010, harmonics to 72 Hz); Gavrilov et al. 2011 JASA 130:3651 (0.12 Hz/yr decline, so 2014 values 0.5 Hz lower); McCauley et al. 2001 Mar. Mamm. Sci. 17:235 (source level 179 dB)

events.label: Earthquake T-phase (recorded)
events.freq: broadband; recorded at Cape Leeuwin IMS H01W1 (flat 1-100 Hz), IMOS gain shape then applied
events.level_rule: scaled to SNR +10 dB; 150 s segment with the peak at chart 90 s; Hann^0.25 taper
events.src: USGS event us20009xz4: 2017-07-19 12:16:23.56 UTC, Mww 6.0, Mauritius-Reunion region, 17.415 S 66.484 E, depth 10 km; epicentre to H01W 5,087 km; record IM.H01W1..EDH (EarthScope FDSN); band SNR at H01W 43.2 dB (30 s, 5-40 Hz)

events.label: Iceberg harmonic tremor
events.freq: fundamental 7.0 Hz with +-3 % slow wander (40 s period); 7 harmonics to 49 Hz, amplitude k^-0.5; 50 s excerpt with 5 s ramps
events.level_rule: scaled to SNR +6 dB; deep-channel transfer sigdet.channel (f0 2.5 Hz, R 3,800 km)
events.src: Chapp et al. 2005 G-cubed 6:Q06003 (Indian Ocean sound-channel variable harmonic tremor: fundamental 4-10 Hz, up to 10 harmonic bands); Talandier et al. 2002 EPSL 203:519; MacAyeal et al. 2008 JGR 113:F03011

events.label: Steep-dive impact (R1)
events.freq: flat to corner 1.592 Hz then f^-3.08; deep-channel transfer (f0 2.5 Hz, Thorp absorption over 1841 km); IMOS gain shape
events.level_rule: scaled to SNR 0 dB; envelope env_gamma rise 1.15 s, decay 11.5 s (power e-fold); spectral tilt 0.0
events.src: source_model_family_quantiles.csv family R1: median fc 1.5919 Hz, median KE 11.2 GJ, median tau 0.1227 s, median slope n 3.076; method imos_inject.synth with sigdet.src_shape and sigdet.channel

events.label: Ditching-like impact (R3)
events.freq: flat to corner 0.372 Hz then f^-3.08; deep-channel transfer (f0 2.5 Hz, Thorp absorption over 1841 km); IMOS gain shape
events.level_rule: scaled to SNR 0 dB; envelope env_gamma rise 1.15 s, decay 11.5 s (power e-fold); spectral tilt 0.0
events.src: source_model_family_quantiles.csv family R3: median fc 0.3725 Hz, median KE 0.553 GJ, median tau 0.5147 s, median slope n 3.075; method imos_inject.synth with sigdet.src_shape and sigdet.channel
